changes.rationale: Primary August 25 02:51 ET release announces favorable Fanapt patent infringement judgment and injunction. Same-day industry reporting attributes rally to ruling. Class 9 applies; this is a litigation resolution, not a new drug approval.

Primary November 2 disclosure and same-session price account identify CMS Bendeka J-code decision as catalyst. Decision triggers $40 million milestone and royalty step-up, rather than FDA approval. Materiality and attribution are established, but resolve reimbursement-decision eligibility under class 7 or 9 before promotion. Old post-election suggestion is chronologically invalid because election was November 8.

Primary full iTotal PS launch was March 2, while April 6 clearance digest lists March FDA decisions. Digest publication is not proof of first public approval news or direct jump attribution. Class 7 or 10 candidate exists but original timing and attributable April 6 cause remain unresolved.

Targeted company/date/Xtampza/legal search did not establish attributable September 22 event. Recovered primary legal update describes February 2016 judgment, before this session; it cannot establish September legal unlock. Leave pending rather than backdate approval or litigation developments.

Recovered primary NantWorks collaboration release is March 16, four months before jump. Later quarterly filing describes July joint-venture funding but does not establish first-public July 16 disclosure or price attribution. Collaboration is an eligible candidate only if session evidence is found.

limitations: No database-derived snapshot or saved news queue refreshed.
Existing price attribution retained unless a conflict is explicitly deferred.
No exhaustive earlier-public search; no training or evaluation gates unlocked.
